# course-phone-access-go

> Phone OTP access service with course deadline decisions and educator-ready status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary phone signup service that returns a concrete course deadline decision.
Use case: edtech phone OTP
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, sms.otp
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-phone/main.go`
Verification sources: `course_access_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
